segments.an11.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati moranivāpe paribbājakārāme.
segments.an11.10:2.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu accantaniṭṭho hoti accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an11.10:2.3: Asekhena sīlakkhandhena, asekhena samādhikkhandhena, asekhena paññākkhandhena –
segments.an11.10:2.4: imehi, kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu accantaniṭṭho hoti accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an11.10:3.1: “Aparehipi, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu accantaniṭṭho hoti accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an11.10:3.4: imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu accantaniṭṭho hoti, accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an11.10:4.1: “Aparehipi, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu accantaniṭṭho hoti accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an11.10:4.4: imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu accantaniṭṭho hoti accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an11.10:5.1: “Dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu accantaniṭṭho hoti accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an11.10:5.4: imehi kho, bhikkhave, dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu accantaniṭṭho hoti accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an11.10:5.5: Brahmunā pesā, bhikkhave, sanaṅkumārena gāthā bhāsitā –
segments.an11.10:6.4: so seṭṭho devamānuse”ti [dī. ni. 1.277; saṃ. ni. 1.182; 2.245].
segments.an11.10:7.1: “Sā kho panesā, bhikkhave, sanaṅkumārena gāthā bhāsitā subhāsitā, no dubbhāsitā; atthasaṃhitā, no anatthasaṃhitā; anumatā mayā.

lines: Dasame accantaniṭṭhoti antaṃ atītattā accantasaṅkhātaṃ avināsadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ niṭṭhā assāti accantaniṭṭho.
Ye gottapaṭisārinoti ye janā tasmiṃ gotte paṭisaranti “ahaṃ gotamo, ahaṃ kassapo”ti, tesu loke gottapaṭisārīsu khattiyo seṭṭho.
Anumatā mayāti mama sabbaññutaññāṇena saddhiṃ saṃsandetvā desitā mayā anuññātā.
Dasame janitasminti kammakilesehi nibbatte, jane etasminti vā janetasmiṃ, manussesūti attho.
Janitasmiṃ-saddo eva vā i-kārassa e-kāraṃ katvā “janetasmi”nti vutto.
Janitasminti sāmaññaggahaṇepi yattha catuvaṇṇasamaññā, tattheva manussaloke.
Khattiyo seṭṭhoti ayaṃ lokasamaññāpi manussalokeyeva, na devakāye brahmakāye vāti dassetuṃ “ye gottapaṭisārino”ti vuttaṃ.
Paṭisarantīti “ahaṃ gotamo, ahaṃ kassapo”ti paṭi paṭi attano gottaṃ anussaranti paṭijānanti vāti attho.
